name: What is an interior build-out?
description: An interior build-out customizes an existing commercial space to fit a tenant's specific business needs.

acceptedAnswer.text: An interior build-out, also known as tenant improvement, is the process of customizing an existing commercial space to meet the specific needs and aesthetic preferences of a new tenant. This can involve reconfiguring floor plans, installing new walls, flooring, ceilings, lighting, plumbing, and electrical systems. It transforms a raw or previously occupied space into a functional and ready-to-use environment for your business operations.
acceptedAnswer.description: An interior build-out customizes an existing commercial space to fit a tenant's specific business needs.
